## Validation

Implementation is in progress. The initial HTTP acceptance test fails because Members has no Remove form. A separate Chromium acceptance test at 390 × 844 also fails because the native confirmation is absent. Focused route and audit tests fail for the missing behavior; the retained current-access characterization passes.

Final candidate checks and accessible evidence will replace this status. Parent: `0ff3f6cdde5be4124df0ed2ab002844d5db1c502`; complete-candidate main base: `9d0546b93d37e74ee9ddc7d9f7f4a66b18de0546`.
